cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Content & Community Manager role. The chance to own content and partnerships for two growing entertainment brands in Flanders, working with sports clubs, athletes and creators, is precisely the kind of hands-on, creative work I want to do.

My experience sits at the intersection of social media, content production and web. As a freelance SEO and WordPress specialist, I designed and built mirook.com for a Belgian youth chess champion, implementing structured data for sports events and athlete profiles, and running iterative audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score. That project taught me how to turn a partnership into content that performs. In my current role at Episto, I manage CMS content for client sites, write SEO blog content and track performance with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Search Console. Earlier, at Knowledge Experts, I built WordPress sites for clients and integrated social media, and I've also worked as a front-end developer, so I'm comfortable with the technical side of publishing and optimising content.

I'm passionate about Belgian sport, especially football and cyclocross, and I understand the Flemish media landscape. I'm comfortable in front of the camera, having produced on-site coverage and interviews, and I enjoy coordinating with external creators and partners. I'm fluent in English, native in Turkish, and improving my Dutch (B1 writing, A2+ speaking).

I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how my mix of content, social media and technical skills can help grow your brands' audiences in Flanders.

Baver Ok
